resource: Live item handles of one GameSession that selected capability 14 CONTAINER_TREE_V1
allocation_impact: Measured as ITEMV0-RL-03 (301) plus, for each of the 16 views (BAGS0-RL-03), its container, which may be visible in no other view, and its 20 entries: 301 + 16 x 21 = 637, above the BAGS-0 floor of 382. The handle table of a capability 14 session is bounded by this value before inserting; a session without capability 14 keeps ITEMV0-RL-03.
boundary_tests: max=637: the views at their bounds hold 637 live handles
max+1=638: the table refuses a handle beyond the views' bounds
notes: BAGS-0 §5 and §10 (ITEMV0-RL-03 re-measured; D469 2a keeps ITEMV0-RL-03 at 301 for sessions without capability 14).
